title: Replacement Card Fee Schedule — Pocketwire Visa Debit Card
content:
The Pocketwire Visa Debit Card replacement fee applies to a replacement physical card issued after a lost or damaged report, once the tier's free replacements are used up. A replacement for a card reported stolen or compromised is always free of the replacement fee.

| Card tier | Replacement card fee (USD) | Free lost or damaged replacements over the rolling 365 days before the new issue date | Stolen or compromised replacement ships expedited at no charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Visa Classic Debit | 5.00 | 1 | no |
| Pocketwire Visa Gold Debit | 5.00 | 1 | no |
| Pocketwire Visa Platinum Debit | 5.00 | 1 | yes |
| Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit | 0.00 | 2 | yes |
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Debit | 0.00 | 2 | yes |
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Metal Debit | 29.99 | 1 | yes |

**Footnotes**

- *Free replacements* are counted over the rolling 365 days that end on the new card's issue date. Only replacements issued for a lost or damaged report count towards them.
- *Expedited at no charge* applies only to replacements for cards reported stolen or compromised. On a tier marked "no", such a replacement is still free of the replacement fee, but expedited shipping is not free of charge.

**Reading across the tiers (hypothetical).** A customer on Pocketwire Visa Infinite Metal Debit has used the tier's one free lost-or-damaged replacement within the rolling 365 days. A further lost-card replacement carries a replacement fee of 29.99. A customer on Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit in the same position still has a second free replacement, and the tier's fee is 0.00 in any case.
